title: Actualization of Manufacturer codes list in t35.c

notes.body:

Why do you make a commit for "Extend BFCP validation by RFC8855" and then immediate revert it in the same MR? This looks strange.

I'm don't know, why it's happen.
 BFCP was in another branch
